# Aurora - Digital Civilization Platform

## Project Overview
Aurora is a comprehensive, emotionally intelligent digital civilization platform that unifies 15 interconnected universes: Home, Entertainment, Commerce, Social, Learning, Create, Brand, Communities, Gaming, Productivity, Travel, Finance, Health & Wellness, Home Control, and Automation & Agents.

## Technology Stack
- **Framework:** Next.js 14+ (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **UI Components:** React
- **Database:** PostgreSQL (schema provided)
- **Authentication:** Next.js Auth

## Architecture Principles
- Unified digital world with coherent experience across all domains
- Adaptive theming: light, dark, illuminated, system modes
- Theme families: home, office, outdoor, lifestyle, creative
- Design language with motion, color, and typography tokens
- Accessibility: high contrast, large text, reduced motion, screen readers
- Ethical AI, privacy-first, autonomous systems governance
- Multi-persona support for different user contexts

## Development Guidelines
- Maintain consistency across all 15 universes
- Follow Aurora's calm, warm, minimal tone
- Use semantic HTML and ARIA attributes
- Implement responsive design across all breakpoints
- Build with accessibility-first mindset
- Document all components and surfaces
- Test across desktop, tablet, mobile
